name: Class Pack
author: Gabriel
description: Extra mischief: a wardrobe with hats and outfits, three new teachers, nerf guns, a phone with DoorDash, prank calls and a bag of tricks (paper airplane, water balloon, super glue, laser pointer, whoopee cushion, notes, naps), a fire alarm, extra poles at the windows, a teacher who eats your snacks, and power cuts in the middle of class.
